no paid fallback ... quota share no we don't limit per group; it runs out as it runs out

overlap_check: No existing methodology on model routing. New.

payload.name: Model Routing Respects the Operator's Chain
payload.description: The operator defines the model fallback chain. It is not replaced, no paid fallback is added, and quotas are not shared or gated. openrouter/free handles its own rotation inside that chain.

principles.name: The chain is the operator's
principles.description: Fallbacks and costs are the operator's choice; the system works within them.

heuristics.action: read the host logs for the per-minute limit before changing anything

heuristics.condition: a proposal adds a model tier or replacement
heuristics.action: check whether it replaces the operator's chain

decision_rules.name: Leave the chain alone
decision_rules.outcome: keep the configured chain as it is (local if enabled for local, free for the VPS) and add nothing paid

decision_rules.name: Handle free rotation inside the free route
decision_rules.outcome: mark it unusable within openrouter/free and use the :free identifiers to pick a usable one; do not pull models out of openrouter/free to lead elsewhere

decision_rules.name: Let quotas run out
decision_rules.outcome: pause and resume when it recovers; do not build sharing, grouping or gating for it

decision_rules.name: No fallback means pause
decision_rules.condition: a host is configured with no fallback
decision_rules.outcome: let the work pause when the model is unavailable and not interfere
